headline: 2003 executive order creates "Volunteers for Prosperity," a federal effort tied to volunteering.
what_it_does: This executive order set up a program called Volunteers for Prosperity. Based on the title, it deals with promoting volunteer service linked to economic well-being. It is generally known as an effort to encourage skilled American professionals to volunteer on development work in other countries. No official summary was provided, so the exact rules and duties are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Skilled American professionals who want to volunteer
who_it_affects.how: The program appears aimed at encouraging them to volunteer, likely in overseas development work.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that run foreign aid and development programs
who_it_affects.how: They may have been given a role in carrying out or coordinating the program.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed September 25, 2003; executive orders usually take effect when signed.
